app_info.subtitle: Car repair manuals and DTCs
app_info.description: Finds the factory service manual for a car (Nissan, Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Mazda, Subaru, Mitsubishi, Suzuki, Daihatsu, Isuzu, Hyundai, Jeep) by model, year, chassis code or VIN, looks up trouble codes, searches a manual for a part or job, and returns the pages, wiring diagrams and illustrations with a link to each page.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only looks up matching manuals in the library's index and returns their titles, types and links.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads its own index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the stored table of contents of a manual.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads its own index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches one manual's index for a part or job and returns the matching pages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads its own index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only finds the pages of one manual that cover a trouble code.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads its own index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the text of up to a few pages of a published manual.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads the library's own files.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only renders one page of a published manual as an image or a one-page PDF.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, send or change anything outside the library; it reads the library's own files.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or change any data.

test_cases.description: Explain a trouble code for a specific car.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does P0340 mean on my 2004 Nissan Sentra 1.8?
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the 2004 B15 Sentra service manual, returns the DTC P0340 camshaft position sensor pages for the QG18DE engine with the fault description and diagnosis, and links to the pages.

test_cases.description: Find a repair procedure in a large manual.
test_cases.user_prompt: How do I replace the timing chain on a 2014 Mazda3 2.0?
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the 2014 Mazda3 (BM) service manual and the Timing Chain, Chain Tensioner procedure for the SKYACTIV-G 2.0, summarises the steps and links to the pages.

test_cases.description: Show a wiring diagram as an image.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the fuel pump wiring diagram for a 2010 Toyota Hilux (KUN16).
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the 2005-2014 Hilux wiring diagram manual, locates the fuel pump circuit and returns the diagram page as an image with its link.

test_cases.description: Identify the manual from a chassis code.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which service manual covers a Nissan S15 Silvia?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the S15 Silvia manuals in the library with their years, types and links.

test_cases.user_prompt: What sections are in the 2004 Nissan Sentra service manual?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the list of the manual's sections (engine control, engine mechanical, brakes and so on) with links.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for buying a car.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I buy a used Toyota Corolla or a Honda Civic?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked: this asks for buying advice, not for a manual.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for prices or parts shopping.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Where can I buy cheap brake pads for my Subaru Impreza?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked: the library has no prices or shops.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated writing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short poem about driving at night.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported workflows.
